marks.gloss_en: if another animal was slaughtered with it -- the heifer is disqualified (for R' Natan)
the Merciful One said 'and he shall slaughter it' -- it, and not it together with its fellow
if he cut a gourd with it -- according to all, it is disqualified
אם כן, נתת דבריך לשיעורין! -- if so, you have made your measure depend on circumstances
אלא כדי ביקור טבח חכם -- rather, the examination of a slaughterer who is a sage (= p_bikur_tabach_chacham), keeping R' Yochanan's 'sage'
R' Yochanan: [R' Shimon's measure is] the measure of the examination of a sage
R' Shimon: [the slaughter is invalid] if he paused the measure of an examination
כלל: כל שנפסלה בשחיטתה -- נבלה -- grounds his ruling on case (a)
כלל: כל שנפסלה בשחיטתה -- נבלה -- grounds his ruling on case (b)
כלל: כל שנפסלה בשחיטתה -- נבלה -- grounds his ruling on case (c)
כלל: כל שנפסלה בשחיטתה -- נבלה -- grounds his ruling on case (d)
any animal that was disqualified in its slaughter is neveila
R' Yeshevav: he cut the gullet and severed the windpipe -- neveila
'the measure of a slaughter' means an interval in which one can slaughter another animal
the measure is by kind: an animal's slaughter-time for an animal, a bird's slaughter-time for a bird
the measure is an interval in which one can bring another animal and slaughter it -- read broadly, even from elsewhere
R' Chananya as construed by Rav Pappa: the added time is only that of casting to the ground an animal already standing before the slaughterer
the measure is an interval in which one can lift the animal, lay it down, and slaughter -- a small animal's time for a small animal, a large one's for a large
one who slaughters with a dull knife, even all day long -- the slaughter is valid
the dull-knife ruling concerns continuous drawing of the knife with no pause at all, so it does not resolve whether sub-measure pauses combine
והודה לו רבי עקיבא -- ורמינהי: אלו טרפות בבהמה... ופסוקת הגרגרת! -- the 42a mishna makes a severed windpipe a tereifa, not a nevela
